title: Share and govern Genie One skills with Unity Gateway (Beta)
body: You can now publish a skill from Genie One and share it with your team, governed by Unity Gateway. Access uses standard Unity Catalog privileges on the catalog and schema that hold the skill. See [Share a skill with your team](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#share-skills) and [Govern skills](/aws/en/ai-gateway/govern-skills).

ref_links.text: Share a skill with your team
